message.content: {"note_claim": "A viral video purporting to show a white aurora over Norway is AI-generated, and similar viral videos have been verified as artificial due to unnatural star movements.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the video was generated using artificial intelligence. It featured stars moving in the sky like dots in some kind of jelly instead of in straight lines, another clue the video was not a real recording.", "reason": "The Lead Stories fact check says a nearly identical viral 'white auroras over Norway' video was AI-generated, citing detection tools and unnatural star movement, which backs the note's claim about similar videos."}

parsed.note_claim: A viral video purporting to show a white aurora over Norway is AI-generated, and similar viral videos have been verified as artificial due to unnatural star movements.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: the video was generated using artificial intelligence. It featured stars moving in the sky like dots in some kind of jelly instead of in straight lines, another clue the video was not a real recording.
parsed.reason: The Lead Stories fact check says a nearly identical viral 'white auroras over Norway' video was AI-generated, citing detection tools and unnatural star movement, which backs the note's claim about similar videos.
